name: mcp-invoice
description: MCP server for invoice generation: an invoice generator that can generate a numbered PDF invoice with VAT for your clients. Numbered invoices with tax lines, rendered to a professional PDF.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

invoice.description: Numbered invoices with tax lines, rendered to a professional PDF.
